scope: Complete upstream Wine visual audits and first shared clear/shader/texture-capability fixes
status: Functional batch complete; full conformance FAIL, stage6 remains open
changes: Clear treats a null rectangle pointer as viewport clear regardless of count, and non-null zero-count rectangles as a no-op. Shared API8/9 core.
VS1.x scalar operands use w after swizzling; legacy LOGP emits exponent/mantissa/logarithm/one rather than a replicated logarithm. Later shader models retain their prior behavior.
Bump-map stages preserve running alpha rather than applying ALPHAOP; disabled generated specular lighting preserves the incoming specular value for programmable pixel shaders.

API8 now exposes the four modulate/add operations already implemented by the shared host. Immutable old caps fixtures remain unchanged; project-owned baseline comparisons explicitly account for exactly these four bits.

Seven additional complete upstream suites are hash-pinned and build with project-owned MinGW ABI declarations. XP timeout is configurable; a started suite is never relaunched into the same log after timeout.

checks.siteConfiguration: 3/4 passed; existing Warcraft catalog test also asserts obsolete local MapleStory disk path. app.js and the test are byte-identical to HEAD bc27efe; unrelated failure retained, not changed or counted as passed.

xpCaps.qualification: API/lifetime probe with simulated readback replies, not GPU pixel evidence. Original complete Wine visual suite supplies actual GPU validation.
